about.heading: About
about.bio:
I'm a Fullstack JavaScript/TypeScript developer who doesn't just write code — I architect digital products that scale, perform, and leave a lasting impression. With deep expertise in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js, I turn complex ideas into clean, production-ready solutions.

I operate at the intersection of engineering precision and creative problem-solving. My edge? I master the art of Vibe Coding and Professional Prompt Engineering — a modern superpower that lets me move at machine speed while maintaining human-level quality. I don't chase trends; I set the pace.

I thrive in high-stakes environments where fast delivery, clean architecture, and attention to detail aren't optional — they're the baseline. Whether solo or leading a team, I bring clarity, ownership, and relentless execution to every project I touch.
